title: Partition Array for Maximum XOR and AND
summary: Given an integer array nums, partition it into three subsequences A, B, and C.
statement: Given an integer array nums, partition it into three subsequences A, B, and C. Each element must be in exactly one subsequence. Maximize the sum of XOR(A) + AND(B) + XOR(C), where XOR and AND are bitwise operations on the elements of the respective subsequences. If multiple partitions yield the same maximum sum, any one of them is acceptable.
constraints: One to 19 positive integers up to one billion.
Partition every element among three possibly empty subsequences.
Maximize XOR(A)+AND(B)+XOR(C), with empty operations worth zero.
hints: Fixing the elements assigned to B fixes its AND and leaves a two-way XOR split over the complement.
Enumerate every B subset and optimize the remaining split with a projected XOR basis.
For complement total XOR T, maximize x+(x xor T)=T+2*(x & ~T) by a basis projected onto complement bits.
Every partition has one enumerated B subset, and the linear basis considers every attainable XOR for A while C receives its complement.
editorial: Every partition has one enumerated B subset, and the linear basis considers every attainable XOR for A while C receives its complement.

tests.explanation: Putting three in A and two in B gives five.
Putting one, two, and three in separate groups gives six.
